title: Student Success Intelligence Framework (SSIF) Datasets
description:
A Multi-Dataset Computational Research Laboratory for Longitudinal Academic Persistence, Employability Phenotypes, Survival Hazards, and Algorithmic Counterfactual Recourse.

SSIF Primary Datasets:
- Academic Retention Panel: 79,239 records across 20,000 students (Curator: Razan Ihab Abdellatif)
- Campus Placement Cohort: 215 MBA candidates (Curator: Amey Thakur)

Full project documentation & code: https://github.com/HarshkumarG007/SSIF
